craftersalmanac.config.enable_all.toolti: Turns the almanac back on for every screen you switched it off on.

craftersalmanac.config.title: Crafter's Almanac Settings
craftersalmanac.config.show_viewer_butto: Adds a button next to the vanilla recipe book button that shows or hides the almanac. Right-click it to open these settings.
craftersalmanac.config.hide_vanilla_butt: Hides the green recipe book button in the inventory, crafting table and furnaces. The almanac button takes its place.
craftersalmanac.config.show_recipe_ids.t: Shows the recipe's ID (like minecraft:oak_planks) when hovering a recipe's result.
craftersalmanac.config.sort_mode.tooltip: How the sort buttons in your inventory and in chests, barrels and other storage order items. Your hotbar is never moved. Off hides the buttons (handy with another sorting mod).
craftersalmanac.sort.name: Name
craftersalmanac.quick_stack.button.hint: Moves items from your inventory that this already has into it (not your hotbar)
While you search, items in the open inventory or chest that don't match fade out, so the matches stand out.
craftersalmanac.config.quick_stack.toolt: Adds a button to chests, barrels and other storage that moves items from your inventory into it when it already has some of them. Your hotbar is never moved.
craftersalmanac.config.tooltip_details.t: Hold Alt over an item to see what food restores, mining speed, durability, how armor compares with yours, compost chance, fuel time and stack size.
craftersalmanac.config.match_station_scr: Frames each recipe card with its station's own screen, so cards match resource packs that style each screen differently. Turn off if a pack's screens make the cards look wrong; every card then uses the recipe book's panel.
craftersalmanac.config.recipe_preview.to: Hold Shift over an item to see its recipe beside the tooltip. Items with more than one recipe go through them, with dots showing how many there are.
